        # L marker is the largest connected component with long straight arms.
        seen=set(); comps=[]
        for p in cells:
            if p in seen: continue
            stack=[p]; seen.add(p); comp=set()
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop(); comp.add((r,c))
                for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if q in cells and q not in seen: seen.add(q); stack.append(q)

        for comp in comps:
            rs=[r for r,c in comp]; cs=[c for r,c in comp]
            if len(comp) >= 10 and (max(rs)-min(rs)+1 >= 5) and (max(cs)-min(cs)+1 >= 5):
